[[File:Fog of War menu.jpg|thumb|300x300px]]
'''Fog of War''' Special Missions are a new type of mission that allows Commanders to stock up on Class Sparks of all kind, T1 to T4, by battling cloaked Bots.

Since January 2020, these Fog of War missions have existed:

* '''Null-Field''' ran from August 15 to 22, 2019.
* '''Apparitions''' ran from November 14 to 20, 2019.
*'''Moving Target''' ran from January 16 to 23, 2020.
*'''Pity '''ran from April 16 to 23, 2020.
*'''Declared''' ran from May 14 to 21, 2020 
*[[Gorilla in the Mist]] - June 24th~July 1st, 2021, a huge gap since the last one... 
*[[Spirit of Ember Future]] - December 23rd ~ December 30th, 2021 
*Gorilla in the Mist again from October 22, 2022 

==Overview ==
The 6x6 square map appears completely empty, but every node is an Ambush from a random bot. The final boss remains uncloaked. They give class spark essence of their respective class when defeated, though this changed in Apparitions to be randomized. The Completion rewards are awarded once but the node rewards can be repeated as many times as one likes.

There are four difficulties of the Null-Field:

*Deception - 10 T1 Class Spark Essence per Fight, 3 energy per node
*Deceit - 60 Class T2 Spark Essence per Fight, 4 energy per node
*Disguise - 135 (Null) 130 (App) T3 Class Spark Essence per Fight, 5 energy per node
*Darken - 35 (Null) 40 (App) T4 Class Spark Essence per Fight, 6 energy per node

Added in Apparitions are special Modules:

*Harness Power on all difficulties. 
*Stagger on T3 and T4.
*Special III on T4.

There are occasional stronger enemies which give four times the essence when defeated.

== Final Bosses ==
* '''Null-Field''': [[Megatronus]]
* '''Apparitions''': [[Optimus Prime]]
* '''Moving Target''': [[Hound]]
* '''Pity''': '''(SG)''' [[Jazz]]
* '''Declared''': [[Tantrum]]

== Transcript (Null-Field) ==
=== Introduction ===
{{Dia|red|[[Marissa Faireborn]]|[[Commander]], the field looks clear but I promise you it is not.}}
{{DiaC|red|[[Teletraan-I|Teletraan]] reports energy spikes indicating a multitude of cloaked hostiles.}}
{{DiaC|red|Ready your team for a fight and proceed at high alert.}}

=== Final ===
{{Dia|purple|[[Megatronus]]|I do not require concealment, you shall witness me and tremble.}}
{{DiaC|purple|The Titan has shared secrets with me, and I soon will have power beyond your pitiful reckoning.}}

== Transcript (Apparitions) ==
=== Introduction ===
{{Dia|red|[[Marissa Faireborn]]|[[Commander]], another cloaking field seems to be set up.}}
{{DiaC|red|[[Energon]] signals all over the map. Not sure if they are coming from that duplicate dimension.}}
{{DiaC|red|You may see some familiar faces, but don't hold back... I don't think they will be playing nice.}}

=== Final ===
{{Dia|red|[[Optimus Prime]]|This form feels strange... wrong... no matter, it shall serve.}}
{{DiaC|red|Destruction is the fate of all sentient beings!}}

== Transcript (Moving Targets) ==

=== Intro: ===
'''[[Marissa Faireborn]]''': ''Commander, [[Hound]] has found a cloaking field and is using it for target practice.''

''I kept trying to explain that TARGET practice usually requires targets you can SEE...''

''He responded "I see them when they blow up, that's good enough for me". So...watch your step I guess?''

=== Final: ===
'''[[Hound]]''': ''Heya Commander, fancy footwork out there. Ya' dodged, dipped, ducked, dived and dodged again.''

''Now lets see if that cute lil' team of yours can do a bullet ballet as you dance around some of my practice rounds.'' 

== Transcript (Pity) ==

=== Intro: ===
'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''Commander, these strange arrivals have re-opened some of the scars on the Multiverse.''

''It looks like we may have a jailbreak from the alternate universe evil [[Jazz]]. He's using the Fog of War to hide...for now.''

''My guess is he'll try and bring reinforcements. So shut him down and send him back home!''

=== Final: ===
'''(SG) [[Jazz]]''': ''Well if it ain't the Commander and his team of fools! Looks like I need to take you back to school!''

''You know I look good as I smash you. Because you gotta' destroy with style, or don't bother destroying at all!''

== Transcript (Declared) ==

=== Intro: ===
'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''Commander, it look like the Fog of War has become a literal fog...of WAR.''

[[Tantrum|''Tantrum'']]'', controlled by [[Necrotronus]], is taking his role as the embodiment of "War" rather seriously.''

''We need to clear the field and end this before he can gather more forces.''

=== Final: ===
'''[[Tantrum]]''': ''YES, COMMANDER! See how the battle makes you glorious. How it feeds you with violence.''

''I almost feel bad for ending you now. You have fought well, but you seek to end War. I shall see it spread across the Universe.''
